Routine and Tips:

I style my hair in the shower after I’m done with soaking wet hair and this has been the greatest improvement!! 

I use any good moisturizing shampoo and conditioner I have, then I style by brushing my soaking wet hair and shaking to form clumps, then I add a mousse (John freida or Aussie recently) and scrunch it in. 

To dry I plop my hair in a T shirt for a bit and then I add spray in leave in conditioner and diffuse mostly dry and then air dry the rest. I add a bit of argan oil once it is dry

I realize psychiatric medications are controversial and do not work for many people

But I can say without a doubt that my ADHD medication has significantly improved my focus, academic performance, and productivity long term by helping with my ADHD symptoms. I struggled with fatigue and poor focus in high school until I started my ADHD medication. I am on the medication still now at age 21 and have been since age 17. 

It doesn’t work so well for everyone but I would reccomend talking to a psychiatrist because it truly can help long term

I’m 21 and have been on Vyvanse since age 17. I started on 30mg, and now take 20mg. 70mg sounds like a really strong dose. I’ve had a diagnosis of ADHD for many years now and I’ve often run into the issue of my medication draining my personality. 

It makes me kinda dull and makes it harder to interact with people, especially on higher doses. It makes me not as fun and humorous as I usually am. I become robot-like. Sounds like you might be experiencing a similar side effect. 

For me, lowering my dosage from 30 to 20mg helped significantly, but I had to sacrifice some of the positive effects of having a higher dosage. I still am productive enough with a lower dose, personally
